The company exhibits a solid operating profile with a 19% operating margin and $749M in operating income on $3,915M of quarterly revenue, supported by a healthy 53% gross margin. However, its balance sheet is highly leveraged with total assets of $79,154M against total liabilities of $57,973M (a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 2.7x), and it faces short-term liquidity pressure with a current ratio of 0.79 ($5,681M in current assets vs. $7,148M in current liabilities). This combination of strong operating profitability but significant leverage and weak short-term liquidity aligns with an investment-grade rating at the lower end of the spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
